༄༅/ /gdugs dkar gyi gdon zlog gegs sel ces bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gdugs dkar gyi gdon zlog gegs sel ces bya ba bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu na ye/ bde gshegs gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*/ / gzhan gyis mi thub bdud bgegs tshogs/ /tshar gcod rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar zhabs la 'dud/ /de la gdugs dkar gyi sgo nas gzhan gyi 'ga' rkyen sel ba'i thabs cung zad cig bshad par bya ste/ de yang 'di'i bzlog chen bya tshul zhig ni logs su 'chad par 'gyur la/ 'dir gzhung 'ga' zhig nas byad bzlog ces grags pa'i cho ga zhig 'byung zhing*/ de la yang mi 'dra ba 'ga' re snang ba las/ gdon zlaug gi bskor dgos pas kha bskang nas 'jug pa bde khul du byas nas 'ga' zhig la phan 'dod kyi bsam pas brjod par bya'o/ /bca' thabs ni/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa/ de'i phyi rol tu pad 'dab gyi dbyibs lta bu'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa/ dbus kyi lte bar zhal yongs rdzogs kyi sku dka' bas/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon gdugs dkar 'dzin pa bkod kyang mi 'gal yang*/ ma grub na dbus nas bzung ste lha rnams kyi gnas thams cad du thig le dang*/ de'i steng du tshom bu lha grangs dang mnyam pa bkod na legs shing*/ gtso mo'i gnas su tsa ka li sogs kyi sku yod na de'i steng du dar ram shog ras dkar po'i gdugs bya/ gnas kyi mdog ni shar phyaugs bzhi'i rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang khur bya'o/ /de ltar byas pa de nyid mdun du stegs kyi khar bzhag ste/ mthar dar ram ras shog sogs kyis bskor nas rgyan gyi brgyan/ /mdun du mchod pa chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga dang 'dod yon dang bcas pa dang*/ gtso mo'i zlum gtor gyi mthar gtor chung nyer gnyis sam ci 'grub dang*/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma yang bya'o/ /de nas bdag mdun gnyis las/ bdag bskyed la lha gzhan la brten pa yang rung mod/ 'dir gdugs dkar nyid kyi bdag bskyed bya ste/

de la yang phyag stong ma dang*/ zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma dang*/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma dang*/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rnams las/ 'dir phyag stong ma'i dbang du bya ste/ de la yang bskyed tshul lha drug bskyed dang*/ cho ga gsum bskyed dang*/ skad cig dkrong bskyed rnams las gang byas kyang mi rung ba mi snang yang*/ 'di'i rgya gzhung rnams nas cho ga gsum bskyed byas pa mang du snang ba ltar bya ste/ thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs byas nas/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las gdugs dkar po'i tog la oṃ yig gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar po can/ dbu stong dang phyag stong mnga' ba/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ sku mdog dkar mo sgaig cing dpa' ba'i nyams ldan/ rtsa zhal nyis brgya dkar/ g.yas zhal nyis brgya ser/ /rgyab zhal nyis brgya dmar/ /g.yon zhal nyis brgya ljang*/ steng zhal nyis brgya sngo/ zhal re re la yang spyan gsum gsum ldan zhing*/ dbu re re la khro bo'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbu'i steng du sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun gyi cod pan 'chang ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i skyabs spyan/ g.yon gyi dang pos gdugs dkar po'i yu ba thugs dkar 'dzin cing*/ g.yas g.yon gyi lhag ma dgu bcu rtsa dgu na 'khor lo dang mda'/ g.yas kyi lhag ma bzhi brgyas rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje rnams brgya phrag re re 'dzin cing*/ g.yon gyi lhag ma bzhi brgyas mda' gzhu dang ral gri dang zhags pa dang lcags kyu rnams brgya phrag re re 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ zhabs g.yas lnga brgya brkyangs pas rgyal po'i chad pa la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa dang*/

g.yon lnga brgya bskums pas mdangs 'phrog ma la sogs pa'i gdon thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa/ sku'i cha thams cad na zur gyis lta ba dang*/ cher bgrad pa la sogs pa'i spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba/ nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'gengs pa/ 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob nus pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ /de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po nas hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar mo can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ /khyod rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ sarba nas shrī ye hūṃ zhes gsungs shing skye bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yin zhabs bsil nas shab+ta āḥhū?ṃ gis rgyud sde 'og ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa si ta ta pa tre ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ rgyal kun mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung*/ /gcig bsdus lha mo'i skur shar ba/ /dran pa yis kyang gdon bgegs tshogs/ /'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rang gi thugs ka'i oṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/

sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon thams cad zhi bar byas/ slar 'dus nas sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa si ta ta pa tre hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ ma ma hūṃ ni swāhā/ zhes pa'i nye snying dang snying po ci 'grub bzlas nas/ yig brgya brjod de/ slar yang mchod bstod byed dam min yang rung ngo*/ /de nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ sgrub gzhi bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar mo can rig sngags kyi lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ rgyal ba'i mtshan mchog gtsug tor las 'khrungs pa'i/ /gzhan gyis mi thub gtsug tor gdugs dkar zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma nyid/ /rig sngags lha mo'i tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol/ /e h+ye hi/ uṣ+ṇī ṣa si ta ta pa tre sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ pho brang gi nang du rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan la bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo can/ dbu stong dang phyag stong mnga' ba/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba/ zhes pa nas/ 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob nus pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ 'khor gyi lha rnams la sku mdog dang phyag mtshan mi 'dra ba gzhan yod kyang 'dir/ de'i shar gyi 'dab ma la gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che g.yas rdo rje/ lhor gtum pa chen mo stobs chen mo g.yas nor bu/ nub tu 'bar ba chen mo gzi brjid che g.yas pad+ma/ byang du dkar mo chen mo stobs chen mo g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ bzhi ka'i g.yon pas 'phreng ba 'dzin cing*/ sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang khu'o/ /mtshams su bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi/

shar gyi rtsibs dang po la 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba gos dkar ma/ gnyis pa la 'phags pa sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ gsum pa la rgyal ba'i rdo rje 'phreng zhes grags ma/ /bzhi pa la pad+ma'i mngon mtshan rdo rje'i mtshan ma ste bzhi ka'ang g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon 'phreng ba 'dzin cing*/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po'o/ /lho'i rtsibs dang po la gzhan gyis mi thub 'phreng ba can/ /gnyis pa la rdo rje mkhar bsnams 'joms pa mo/ /gsum pa la zhib lha rnams kyis mchod ma/ bzhi pa la gzugs bzhi gzi brjid chen mo can rnams g.yas rin po che dang g.yon ut+pa la 'dzin cing*/ thams cad kyang sku mdog ser po'o/ /nub kyi rtsibs dang po la 'phags ma sgrol ma stobs mo che/ gnyis pa la rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan ma/ gsum pa la rdo rje gzhon nu rig 'dzin ma/ bzhi pa la lag na rdo rje rigs gser 'phreng rnams g.yas ut+pa la dmar po dang g.yon 'phreng ba 'dzin cing*/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po'o/ /byang gi rtsibs dang po la leb rgan rtsi dang rin chen ma/ gnyis pa la snang mdzad rdo rje gtsug tor grags ma/ gsum pa la rnam par bsgyings ma rdo rje can/ bzhi pa la gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ma rnams g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang g.yon ut+pa la'i 'phreng ba 'dzin cing*/ thams cad kyang sku mdog ljang khu'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams su/ rdo rje 'gros dang dkar mo dang*/ pad+ma'i spyan dang zla 'od dang*/ sangs rgyas dpal dang de bzhin spyan/ rdo rje nyi ma'i 'od dang ni/ de bzhin zla ba rdo rje 'dzin rnams rang rang gi sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs dang bcas pa ste/ thams cad kyang zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis zla gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrogs/ byang sgor rdo rje dril bu ma ste/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs dang bcas pa/

de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ mchod pa byin brlab ni gong du'am/ 'dir byed na sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs bskyed de byin gyis brlab/ 'on kyang 'dir 'dod yon lnga sogs kyang byin brlab bya/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra nas hoḥ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum/ phyogs bcu'i mchod tshogs thams cad dang*/ /bdag gis bshams pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs la/ /'bul lo bzhes la dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta si ta ta pa tre sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil sogs sbyar nas shap+ta'i bar dang*/ rū pa nas spar sha'i bar gzugs mchog sogs sbyar nas 'bul/ gzhan yang rin chen sna bdun dang*/ gling bzhi nyi zla ri rab bcas/ /bcom ldan=/ 'bul lo=/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas wa ra ma hā sap+ta rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes mchod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi mtshan mchog gtsug tor nas/ /legs par 'khrungs pa'i rmad byung lha mo ni/ /gzhan gyis mi thub gtsug tor gdugs dkar zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sprul pa'i dbu dang phyag ni stong ldan cing*/ /bye ba brgya stong spyan mnga' sgeg dpa' sogs/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan mi phyed mtshan rtags can/ /bcom ldan 'das ma khyod la gus pas bstod/ /ma lus gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs kun dang*/ /phyi nang bar chad mi mthun phyogs thams cad/ /zhi mdzad drag shul che sogs rig sngags kyi/ /lha mo'i tshogs la gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'am/ rgyas par na/ rgyal ba bye ba bdun dang 'phags pa'i 'khor/ /zhes sogs kyi bstod pa rgyas pa brjod/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ gtso mo'i thugs ka'i oṃ yig gi mthar zhes pa nas sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur/ tād+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bai ra bai ra/

sau me sau me/ sarba bud+dha ā dhiṣ+ṭha na ā dhiṣ+ṭhi te swāhā/ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa si ta ta pa tre hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ ma ma hūṃ ni swāhā/ zhes pa ci 'grub dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta man gang mang bzlas la yig brgya brjod/ de nas zlum gtor bzang po rgyan ldan bshams pa la chab bran te bsangs/ sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs byas la/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa si ta ta pa tre sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis bsngos nas gzhi bdag gtor ma yang 'bul zhing*/ legs ldan sogs la mchod tshul zhig 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ /de nas bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūṃ/ bcom ldan mthu rtsal thogs pa med/ bdud dang gdon bgegs ma lus pa/ /'dul mdzad gar dgu'i nyams ldan pa/ /gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bde gshegs gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*/ /sprul pa'i zhal phyag stong phrag dang*/ /spyan ni bye ba brgya stong can/ /gtso mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gang gi mtshan brjod dran pas kyang*/ /gdon dang bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun/ /zlog mdzad mthu rtsal stobs ldan pa'i/ /rigs sngags lha mo'i tshogs la bstod/ /bh+yo/ gtso mo bcom ldan gdugs dkar mo/ /gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu zlog /gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che/ /lha yi gdon tshogs zlog tu gsol/ /gtum pa chen mo stobs chen mo/ /klu yi gdon tshogs zlog=/ 'bar ba chen mo gzi brjid can/ /lha min=/ 'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mo/ /rlung lha'i=/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba gos dkar mo/

/mkha' lding =/ 'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ /dri za'-i=/ rgyal ba'i rdo rje 'phreng zhes grags/ /mi 'am ci'i gdon zlog=/ pad+ma'i mngon mtshan rdo rje'i mtshan/ /lto 'phye'i gdon tshogs=/ gzhan gyis mi thub 'phreng ba can/ /gnod sbyin=/ rdo rjai mkhar bsnams 'joms pa mo/ /srin po'i=/ zhi ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod ma/ yi dwags=/ gzugs bzhi gzi brjid chen mo can/ /sha za'i=/ /'phags ma sgrol ma stobs mo che/ /'byung po'i=/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan ma/ /grul bum=/ rdo rje gzhon nu rig 'dzin ma/ /srul po'i=/ lag na rdo rje'i rigs gser 'phreng*/ /lus srul gdon=/ leb rgan rtsi dang rin chen ma/ /skem byed=/ snang mdzad rdo rje gtsug tor grags/ /brjed byed=/ rnam par bsgyings ma rdo rje can/ smyo byed=/ gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ba/ /grib gnon=/ rdo rje 'gros dang dkar mo can/ /gnon po'i gdon=/ pad+ma'i spyan dang zla 'od ma/ /nam gru'i=/ sangs rgyas dpal dang de bzhin spyan/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i 'od dang ni/ /de bzhin zla ba do rje 'dzin/ /gdon rigs thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /god kha bzlog pa'i ched lta bu yin na/ god kha god 'dre ngan pa dang*/ /lha yi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol/ /zhes sbyar zhing*/ gzhan la yang 'gre'o/ /bh+yo/ bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs kyis/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu zlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga=/ glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /yi 'brog sum brgya drug cu zlog /rbod gtong byad kha phur kha zlog /rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /dus min 'chi ba thams cad zlog /god kha god 'dre thams cad zlog /za 'dre phung 'dre thams cad zlog /mi kha bram mchu thams cad zlog /byur 'dre ngan pa thams cad zlog /lo zla zhag skeg thams cad zlog / mdor na mi mthun mi shis pa'i/

/gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe ring nad med longs spyod sogs/ /legs tshogs thams cad rgyas par mdzod/ /ces 'phrin las bcol ba lan gcig gam gsum bya/ de nas yungs kar dang bye ma sogs la/ gdug dkar gyi sngags dang*/ rta mgrin phyag rdor sogs kyi drag sngags btab te bzhag /bgegs gtor ting lo 'chang bu bcas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po mgron rnams mnyes par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros gnod byed gdon bgegs lan chags kyi mgron rigs thams cad spyan drangs/ e h+yai hi/ pad+ma ka ma la ya staṃ/ oṃ a ka ro nas oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā lan bdun rnam gsum gyis bsngos nas/ kye/ steng 'og bar gsum dbye ba yi/ / gdon bgeg 'byung po'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /zas su mngal za khrag 'thung sogs/ /gdon gyi rigs gyur thams cad dang*/ /lan chags bu lon gyur pa yi/ /gnod byed kun dang khyad par du/ /rnal 'byor sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs la/ /mar me 'chang bu sogs bcas pa'i/ /'dod yon lnga ldan gtor ma 'di/ /'bul lo bzhes nas bdag cag la/ /phyin chad gnod pa mi byed par/ /rang rang so so'i gnas su song*/ /gal te gnod sems dang bcas te/ /mi 'gro gnas 'dir 'dug byed na/ /gdugs dkar lha tshogs thugs khros nas/ /sku las spros pa'i khro bo dang*/ /mi bzad mtshon cha'i char phab ste/ /brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ zhes dang*/ sum+bha ni'i sngags brjod cing*/ yungs kar sogs kyis brab la/ gu gul gyis bdug par bya'o/ de nas bum pa'i nang du dri bzang gi chu blugs la bsags sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

oṃ yig gi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba zhi khro thams cad kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas sngags 'phreng la thim pas de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du gyur par bsams la/ gdugs dkar gyi sngags gong du brjod pa de dang*/ rnam 'joms kyi sngags dang sngags gzhan ci ltar rigs pa zla zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ bsgrub bya mdun du 'khod pa la bum chu blud de bkru ba dang lhan cig gdugs dkar dang rnam 'joms kyi sngags tshar re sngon du btang nas/ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye sāhā/ /de bzhin du gdon thams cad dang*/ rims thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ khon thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ byad thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ /grib thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ ltas ngan pa thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ /bkra mi shis pa thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ /rmi ltas ngan pa thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ nye bar 'tshi ba thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ bar gcod mi mthun pa'i phyos thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ de nas bden brjod byas nas khrus chu phyir 'dor/ 'dod na sngags snga ma brjod cing*/ rma bya'i sgros byabs te sngar gyi tshig nad thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā zhes sogs la a pa na ye swāhā sbyar ba dang*/ nad thams cad las rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swāhā/ zhes sbyar nas srung ba dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams ni zhes sogs kyi bden tshig khyad brjod par bya'o/ /bsdu na/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ zhes sogs brjod pas kyang 'grub bo/ /de nas mjug tu/ slar mchod bstod dang bzod gsol bkra shis bcas bya'o/ /dngos gzhis ni des grub cing*/ gnod pa zlog pa la ni legs ldan mched gsum dang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams la gtor 'bul dang bcas pa'i 'phrin las bcol bar byas na yang legs pas/

de'i tshul ni/ sngar gyi dkyil 'khor bris pa de'i sgo'i phyi rol nas sor gsum mam bzhi nas gru bzhi'i rnam pa byas la/ shar sgo'i mdun 'thud dbus dang g.yas g.yon gsum du tshom bu dang*/ phyogs mtshams gzhan rnams su grol nas sogs kyi me tog bkram/ legs ldan rnams la gtor ma gsum mam gcig /'jig rten pa rnams la gtor ma brgyad dam thun mong du gcig dang*/ mchod pa rnams sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ mgron rnams spyan 'dren pa ni/ sngon ma'i gtang rag sogs ma byas pa'i bar der/ rang gdugs dkar mo can du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros so so'i rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i bka' srung legs ldan mched gsum dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad/ sde dpon dgu la sogs pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ ma hā kā la lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra e h+ya hi badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ /zhes dang rgyas par na/ kyai/ rgyal yum gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i/ /bka' sgrub bstan srung mthu rtsal can/ /legs ldan nag po mched gsum dang*/ /rgyal chen phyogs skyong lha chen dang*/ /klu chen gza' chen rgyu skar dang*/ /'jigs byed chen po dgu la sogs/ /'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyang*/ /mchod sbyin gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyis/ /brtse bas dgongs te gshegs su gsol/ /shar sgo'i phyi rol tu legs ldan mcher gsum dang*/ gzhan rnams so so'i gnas su bzhugs par gyur/ ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de nas mchod pa ni/ lha mi'i mchod yon dam pa dang*/ bdag gis 'bul ba'i mchod yon 'di/ /legs ldan 'jig rten skyong rnams la/ /'bul 'byin bzhes nas bdag cag dang*/ /sbyin bdag mi nor 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen zlog la mthun rkyen sgrubs/

/oṃ shrī ma hā kā la lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil sogs sbyar nas shap+ta'i bar dang*/ gzugs mchog dang rū pa sogs sbyar nas 'dod yon kyang 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i bka' sgrub cing*/ /gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun/ /tshar gcod legs ldan drag po sogs/ /legs ldan mched gsum nyid la bstod/ /sa 'og sa steng thams cad du/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu yis dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /legs nyes sna tshogs ston byed pa'i/ /dpal mgon rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te/ /legs ldan 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pā ri wa ra i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun dang*/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ srin po'i gzugs kyi tshul bstan nas/ /gdug pa can kun 'dul mdzad kyang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa ste/ /gtum po mched la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te/ /'jig rten pa rnams kyi ljags nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ma hā ra dz+wa dik+ka pā la ma hā de ba nā ga rā dzā gṛ ha nak+ṣaṃ tra bai ra wa sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun nam gsum gyis dbul la/ phyi rol khor yug la gnas pa'i/ rgyal chen lha klu gza' skar dang*/ /'jig byed la sogs mthu ldan pa'i/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la bstod/ /de nas 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ kye/ bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs kyi/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rnams/ /tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad bstan srung gtso/ /legs ldan mched gsum 'khor bcas dang*/ /srid pa gsum na gnas pa dang*/ /rgyu ba'i dregs ldan kun gyi rje/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu/ /lha chen brgya dang klu chen

brgyad/ /gza' chen brgyad dang rgyu skar tshogs/ /'jigs byed chen po 'khor bcas kyis/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes nas/ /rnal byor sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa yi/ /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu zlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu zlog /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga zlog /gdon chen phal pa bcu bzhi zlog /byad kha phur kha thams cad zlog /rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub tham cad zlog /god kha god 'dre thams cad zlog /za 'dre phung 'dre thams cad zlog /mi kha gram mchu thams cad zlog /gza' dang rgyu skar gnod pa zlog /btsan dang rgyal po'i gnod pa zlog /klu dang sa bdag gnod pa zlog /bdud dang 'gong po'i gnod pa zlog / mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod sogs/ /legs tshogs thams cad rgyas pa dang*/ /srung skyob byed pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bsdu na des chog cing*/ dngos grub zhu tshul rgyas par byed na/ kyai/ legs ldan 'jig rten skyong rnams kyis/ /rnal 'byor sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /lus srog brtan pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /dbang thang dar ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /klung rta dar ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /gser dngul rin chen dngos grub stsol/ /dar zab gos bzang dngos grub stsol/ /myur mgyogs rta yi dngos grub stsol/ /'dod 'jo bzhon ma'i dngos grub stsol/ /sna tshogs 'bru yi dngos grub stsol/ /ro brgya'i zas kyi dngos grub stsol/ /smra mkhas gtam gyi dngos grub stsol/ /dpa' rtsa mthu yi dngos grub stsol/ /snyan grags rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /rigs brgyud 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /phun tshogs 'khor gyi dngos grub stsol/

/bkra shis dpal gyi dngos grub stsol/ /de la sogs pa srid gsum na/ /legs pa'i dngos grub ci mchis pa/ /thams cad rnal 'byor sbyin bdag la/ /thogs med lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces pa lta bu dang gzhan yang brjod par bya'o/ / zor 'phen 'dod na'ang 'ug sgro can gyi skyer mda' dang khrag zor dug zor gtor zor rnams 'phen par bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /lo tog gi rim gro'i dus su zlog pa sogs la dmigs bsal gyi spel tshig sbyor tshul shes dgos la/ der ma zad rigs brgyud kyi don dang*/ bde srung gi ched du byed na'ang sngar ltar 'phrin las bcol na legs so// //mjug tu ji ltar bya ba ni/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ dang po gdugs dkar lha tshogs la tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas sam sngags kyang gis mchod nas/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya/ de nas legs ldan sogs la yang sngar ltar rgyas bsdus gang rung gis mchod cing*/ bstod la/ yig brgya brjod de/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ zhes sogs kyis bzod gsol dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /rnal 'byor sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /dngos grub stsol cing 'phrin las mdzad pa legs/ /nga ni so so'i rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ bde gshegs thugs rjes gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*/ /zhes pa nas/ bde mchog gdugs dkar can gyi bkra shis shog /zhes dang*/ bsngau smon bya'o/ / ces pa 'di yang la mar nang gi sngags bon dang ldan rnams kyis bskul ba ltar/ shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis rgya bod kyi gzhung 'ga' zhig dang bstun te gzhan la yang phan srid snyam nas co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba ste/ dad stobs ldan pa'i sngags 'chang sna lam rdo rje dbang phyug gis par du sgrub pa'i tshe/ yi ge pa ni tho lo'i sngags 'chang tshe dbang mgon po'o/
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ gdugs dkar gyi gdon zlog gegs sel bzhugs/ - PAGE 16-- PAGE 17-- PAGE 1-
